title: Preparation of Gelatin Slide Coating Solution
author: Allen Institute for Brain Science
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bfzvjp66
materials: Preparation of Gelatin Slide Coating Solution
Chrome alum, Chromium (III) Potassium Sulfate dodecahydrate (Sigma 243361 or equivalent)
Warning: Personal Protective Equipment () should be used at all times while operating this protocol. If you are unsure what you should be using, see your immediate supervisor.
Determine the required volume of gelatin solution.

steps.title: Prepare Glass Container
steps.instruction: Select a glass Erlenmeyer flask or beaker of an appropriate size (e.g., 500 ml) based on the desired yield of the solution.

steps.title: Add Water and Heat
steps.instruction: Add the required volume of MilliQ water to the glass container and heat it to 65°C on a heated stir plate.

substeps.instruction: For 100 ml final volume: use 100 ml MilliQ water
For 250 ml final volume: use 250 ml MilliQ water
For 500 ml final volume: use 500 ml MilliQ water

steps.title: Dissolve Gelatin Powder
steps.instruction: Gently add the Type A, 275 bloom gelatin powder (Fisher G8-500 or equivalent) to the 65°C water, avoiding clumps.

substeps.instruction: For 100 ml final volume: add 300 mg gelatin powder
For 250 ml final volume: add 750 mg gelatin powder
For 500 ml final volume: add 1500 mg gelatin powder
Stir gently until the solution is clear and gelatin is dissolved, avoiding the introduction of bubbles

steps.title: Add Chromium Potassium Sulfate
steps.instruction: Add the Chromium Potassium Sulfate to the dissolved gelatin solution and stir until dissolved.

substeps.instruction: For 100 ml final volume: add 50 mg Chromium Potassium Sulfate
For 250 ml final volume: add 125 mg Chromium Potassium Sulfate
For 500 ml final volume: add 250 mg Chromium Potassium Sulfate

steps.title: Cool and Coat Slides
steps.instruction: Reduce heat and cool the gelatin solution to approximately 50°C.

steps.title: Dispose of Unused Solution
steps.instruction: Dilute any unused solution ≥2X with warm water and pour it down the municipal drain.

steps.title: Clean Containers
steps.instruction: Rinse containers thoroughly with hot water, followed by cleaning with MilliQ water and 70% EtOH.
